why: Example invocations of the flow editor's verbs that act on its demo example (widgets slider, add, preview; synapses s1 slider@number->add@a, s2 add@sum->preview). The declared-verb law (`artifact_app_laws::assert_declared_verbs_honour_their_declarations`) boots every probe with `setActiveExample` below and overlays these arguments on the staged declared defaults, so every declared argument is probed on an invocation that can act.
